data.case_title: Dunning notice from MusterFit Studios for returned direct debit (November membership fee)
data.title: Payment reminder (Mahnung) – returned direct debit for gym membership fee
data.summary: MusterFit Studios GmbH informs Tobias Beispiel that the direct debit for the November 2025 membership fee (Mitgliedsbeitrag) was returned by his bank ("wurde von Ihrer Bank zurückgegeben"). They demand payment of the outstanding EUR 39.90 plus a EUR 7.50 dunning fee, totalling EUR 47.40, by 12.12.2025.
data.explanation: Your bank did not process the automatic payment for your November gym fee, so the gym is now asking you to pay the missing amount yourself, plus a small fee to cover the bank charge caused by the failed direct debit. You should transfer the total amount to the given account by the stated date, or make sure there are enough funds if they try the direct debit again. If you already paid, you can ignore this letter, as it says itself. If you don't pay, further reminders or debt collection could follow, so it's best to settle it or contact the gym if you think this is a mistake.

items.title: Pay outstanding gym fee plus dunning fee
items.quote: Wir bitten Sie, den offenen Betrag spätestens am 12.12.2025 auszugleichen.
items.action: Transfer EUR 47.40 to the gym's account by the stated date.
